metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-ai[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Published bead pages and the SASE_BEAD commit tag[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every bead that a SASE agent commits against has a beautiful, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]self-healing GitHub page in the project's `--beads` sidecar that [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]links out to its plan, its agents, its commits, and its related [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]beads, and every commit reaches it through a `SASE_BEAD` footer tag[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]instead of a parenthetical bolted onto the headline.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]bead_pages.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bead page address contract and hosted bead URLs[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]pathing[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pathing: define the deterministic bead page path, carry the beads [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sidecar remote on the resolved store, and teach the shared hosted-link [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolver to turn a bead id into an absolute GitHub URL.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]SASE_BEAD commit tag replaces the headline parenthetical[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tag[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pathing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tag: stop appending ` (<bead_id>)` to commit and PR headlines and write [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a linked `SASE_BEAD=` footer tag instead, resolved best-effort and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]local-only.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Derived bead association index[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]associations[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pathing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]associations: derive each bead's commits and agents in one repository [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]walk from `SASE_BEAD` tags, the legacy headline parenthetical, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`SASE_AGENT` tags, and bead-derived agent names, then roll descendants [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]up into their root bead.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bead page rendering[/bold #D7AFFF]                                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]rendering[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pathing, associations[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rendering: render one bead page per bead — identity, plan, description, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lineage, phases, dependencies, agents, and commits — as deterministic, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]timestamp-free, bounded Markdown.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Post-commit lineage publication[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]publish[dim] · [dim][/dim]after rendering[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]publish: after a primary commit carrying a `SASE_BEAD` tag, re-render [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that bead's whole lineage into the beads sidecar, write only what [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]changed, commit, and push asynchronously, strictly best-effort.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Regenerable-page conflict class[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]conflicts[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pathing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]conflicts: teach the bead conflict resolver that generated pages are [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]regenerable projections so a page conflict resolves automatically [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of wedging every bead rebase in the sidecar.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bulk refresh command and lineage roster[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]reconcile[dim] · [dim][/dim]after publish[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]reconcile: add `sase bead pages refresh` and `sase bead pages url`, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]let the refresh path own the `pages/README.md` roster that per-commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publication deliberately never touches.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reciprocal BEAD bullet in the plan header block[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]planlink[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pathing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]planlink: add a `BEAD` section to the sase-core plan-header block [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar and render it from each plan's existing bead frontmatter so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plans link back to bead pages.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Documentation and discoverability surfaces[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after reconcile, tag[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs: update the generated beads sidecar README, the commit-workflow and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bead documentation, and make `sase bead show` print the bead's page URL.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Publish every project's bead pages[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]rollout[dim] · [dim][/dim]after reconcile, conflicts, docs[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rollout: run the bulk refresh against every enabled project, verify the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]published links resolve, and confirm a real `sase commit` produces a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]working `SASE_BEAD` link.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
